senses.gloss: कृ [cf. Hib. caraim, ‘I perform, execute’; ceard, ‘an art, trade, business, function’; sucridh, ‘easy’; Old Germ. karawan, ‘to prepare’; Mod. Germ. gar, ‘prepared (as food)’; Lat. creo, ceremonia; κραίνω, κρόνος.]

2. कृ cl. 3. P. p. चक्र॑त् (Pot. 2. sg. चक्रियास्; aor. 1. sg. अकार्षम् [AV. vii, 7, 1] or अकारिषम् [RV. iv, 39, 6]),
to make mention of, praise, speak highly of (gen.), RV.; AV. :
Intens. (1. sg. चर्कर्मि, 1. pl. चर्किराम, 3. pl. चर्किरन्; Impv. 2. sg. चर्कृता॑त् and चर्कृधि; aor. 3. sg. Ā. च॑र्कृषे) id., RV.; AV. (cf. कारु॑, कीरि॑, कीर्ति॑.)

2. कॄ (or v.l. कृ) cl. 5. 9.P. Ā. कृणोति, ˚णुते, ˚णाति, ˚णीते, to hurt, injure, kill, Dhātup.; Vop. xvi, 2;
 कृण्व॑ति, Naigh. ii, 19.

2. कॄ (or v.l. कृ) cl. 5. 9.P. Ā. कृणोति, ˚णुते, ˚णाति, ˚णीते, to hurt, injure, kill, Dhātup.; Vop. xvi, 2;
 कृण्व॑ति, Naigh. ii, 19.

3. कॄ (v.l. for गॄ) cl. 10. Ā. कारयते, to know, Dhātup. xxxiii, 33;
to inform, ib.
